summary: Milestone 2 Part B3 'Pickleball Authenticity' FRONTEND verification PASS. (A) Headless engine suite `cd /app/frontend && npx tsx src/game/__tests__/run.ts` → RESULT: 263 passed, 0 failed. All three B3 pillars verified by the suite itself: §1 serve-return/third-shot never struck on bounce frame (177 returns + 164 thirds across seeded matches), post-bounce contact >=0.1s after bounce (0.09999..≈0.1s), scripted human normal returns show 0 false TWO_BOUNCE faults across 130 attempts (89 legal); §2 non-hitting partner holds the line (hitter y=29.5 partner y=29.5), a lob over the line correctly drops partner back (y=34.7), all-four-at-net formation now reached (ROOKIE 27.9%, CLUB 48.4%, PRO 52.6% — meets ‘>0% rookie’ and ‘clearly above B2 33/36 for CLUB/PRO’), rally lengths within ±15% baseline (7.69/10.79/11.97), KITCHEN personality time-at-line > DEFENSIVE (60% vs 46%); §3 short bounced dinks (AI and human) step into kitchen, play bounced ball legally, exit, re-establish — 0 kitchen faults, 0 stuck across seeded AI matches. Line-landing dinks are NOT forced into the kitchen (correct). (B) `npx tsx src/game/__tests__/b3Report.ts 30` → no stuck in any tier (ROOKIE/CLUB/PRO stuck=0), sameFrame 0.0% in both ret-only and ret+3rd buckets across all three tiers (ret/3rd sameFrame=0.0%, ret 0.0%), post-bounce contact 156/149/127ms (all >=100ms), all-four-at-net 28.4/48.2/52.9%, oppWin 3/43/90% (healthy skill gradient). (C) Web preview smoke 390x844 on https://pickleball-b3.preview.emergentagent.com — main-menu-screen loads clean; Quick Match → CLUB → match-screen renders court + 4 players + HUD + DEV toggle; tactical-row contains lob-button + kitchen-button both tappable (kitchen flipped state 'BACK ▼' / now '● at net' → state 'NET ▲' / now '● back' after one tap+cooldown, confirming Pressable+cooldown wired correctly); pause-button opens pause-overlay, resume-button removes it cleanly; 20 seconds of continuous play produced ZERO console errors, ZERO pageerror events, no red-box, no Expo render-error overlay. No engine or tuning changes made.
